verdict.rationale: Ultrametric's own `init` command writes SKILL.md files into the skill directories of Codex (.agents/skills) and Claude Code (.claude/skills), and a hands-on dry run confirmed both targets. Those are the locations those hosts load skills from, but nothing shows the skill descriptions or how they trigger from task context. Automatic activation itself is a host behavior and earns no credit on its own. Missing for 10: the skill description or trigger text, any documentation of context-based activation design, and hands-on evidence that the skill activates at the right moment.

support.subject: As a developer, installed skills trigger automatically from task context, with descriptions engineered so the agent activates the right skill at the right moment

citations.quote: The second writes the selected skill files.
The CLI can add Ultrametric instructions to a project for Codex and Claude Code.
